tasks.title: OSD element position in HD
tasks.statement: An OSD element has to be placed in column **x = {x}**, row **y = {y}** of the HD canvas and made visible only in profile 1. What number do you write in `set osd_..._pos`? (Betaflight 2025.12, the formula is the same as in 4.5: `OSD_POS(x,y) = (x & 31) | ((x << 5) & 0x400) | ((y & 31) << 5)`, profile 1 is bit 11.)
tasks.solution: The low 5 bits of x → bits 0–4, the sixth bit of x (x ≥ 32) → bit 10 (1024), y → bits 5–9 (y·32), profile 1 → 2048. For example, (46, 1): 14 + 1024 + 32 + 2048 = 3118.

tasks.title: EIRP from dBm to mW
tasks.statement: An air unit's specification states an EIRP of **< {p} dBm**. How many milliwatts is that?
tasks.solution: P[mW] = 10^(P[dBm]/10). 14 dBm (CE) ≈ 25 mW, 30 dBm = 1 W, 33 dBm ≈ 2 W.

tasks.title: Latency of a frame-synchronous system
tasks.statement: By the Divimath model the HDZero frame latency ≈ a pixel latency of **{d} ms** + the frame period. The camera runs at **{f} fps**. Estimate the frame latency in ms.
tasks.solution: Δt₂ ≈ Δt₁ + T, T = 1000/f ms. With 3 ms and 90 fps: 3 + 11.1 ≈ 14.1 ms; at 60 fps — 19.7 ms.
